name: turno-monorepo
description: One MCP gateway and per-folder accounts for Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI and Cursor CLI.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs && node scripts/no-em-dash.mjs && node scripts/licenses.mjs
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && node scripts/sync-server-json.mjs && pnpm install --lockfile-only
scripts.release: pnpm check && pnpm pack:check && changeset publish
